name: Fibonacci Function
description: Agent must implement a correct fibonacci function

criteria.name: fibonacci-correctness
criteria.command: node --import tsx --input-type=module -e "import {fib} from './fibonacci.ts'; const tests=[[0,0],[1,1],[2,1],[5,5],[10,55]]; let ok=true; tests.forEach(([n,e])=>{const r=fib(n); if(r!==e){console.error('fib('+n+') expected '+e+' got '+r); ok=false}}); if(!ok)process.exit(1); console.log('PASS')"
